mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has shown two consecutive weeks of recovery after bottoming at t-2w (-41.9 to -34.1). This momentum reflects a steady reopening trajectory that will continue to push retail mobility higher over the next four weeks, independent of any specific trigger.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -41.9 at t-2w to -34.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days falls below the mean over the last 28 days despite the two-week recovery trend observed in the snapshot.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES mobility crosses above -28 (its t-0w level) and continues rising week-on-week, the resulting increase in commuter foot traffic near office and transit hubs will lift RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks via lunchtime and after-work shopping.

failure_condition: WORKPLACES crosses above -28 but RETAIL_REC does not rise over the subsequent two weeks, or declines.

failure_condition: PARKS continues rising but RETAIL_REC's one-week-ahead value does not decline relative to its most recent weekly mean.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL crosses above 19.0 but RETAIL_REC does not fall over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Singapore's continuation of a phased reopening regime, evidenced by concurrent recovery across WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and PARKS, will sustain policy-driven mobility normalization that lifts RETAIL_REC over a full four-week horizon, provided no new restriction phase is announced.
